name: Georgia Tech
summary: Georgia Tech is a public technological university in Atlanta, established in 1885. All first-year applicants must submit SAT or ACT results. Its BS in Computer Science is built around "Threads": each student combines two areas such as intelligence, systems and architecture, theory, or people.

testing.notes: At least one SAT or ACT result is required from every first-year applicant.

internationalTuition.notes: Out-of-country first-years; mandatory student fees add US$1,716.

livingEstimate.notes: On-campus housing US$8,318 plus food US$6,310.

scholarships.name: Institutional scholarships (limited for international students)
scholarships.eligibility: International students cannot receive federal or state aid, and scholarships administered by Georgia Tech's financial aid office are often not awarded to them.

admissionStats.notes: "Almost 67,000" applied and "more than 8,500" were admitted; admit rate 30% for Georgia residents and 9% for nonresidents.

admissionProcess.detail: Non-Georgia and international students: Early Action 2 by 2 November 2026 (decisions late January) or Regular Decision by 6 January 2027 (mid-March).
Self-report SAT/ACT by the round's test deadline (8 December for EA2; 22 January for RD).
International applicants meet the University System of Georgia's English requirement (TOEFL or IELTS).
International students must document funding for the full programme to receive an I-20.
